answer: Ferrous Refusal Ledger. Each identity gets one ferrous token that decays; a clone must acquire a fresh inlet from the ledger, but the ledger refuses any inlet whose funding trace touches an already-used token. Every duplicating attempt therefore pays full acquisition cost while yielding a token the ledger will reject at first use, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV. The pulse of decay timing is randomized per token, so copying a neighbor's schedule gains nothing.
